mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and 70 degrees down by Fireman's Park, with a Waning Gibbous moon overhead.

The City of Verona has two important updates for residents. First, road surface treatments are scheduled from August 4th through the 7th, starting on Lincoln Street. Second, if you replace an older toilet with a high efficiency model, you may qualify for a 100 dollar rebate through the city sewer utility program.

There is plenty to do in our community. Today, you can enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard. Tomorrow, August 1st, features the Remote Area Medical clinic at the high school, the Sugar River Paddle and Jamboree, and the Dane County Farmer's Market.
Regarding local safety, on July 26th, a 55 year old driver was arrested for O W I after being pulled over for driving 97 miles per hour on US Highways 18 and 151.
The Culver's in Verona is currently closed but will open its doors at 10 AM. If you are craving something sweet tomorrow, the flavor will be Chocolate Volcano.
